newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs rise on buy-backs, supported by EPA report.
newsitem.headline: JGBs rise on buy-backs, supported by EPA report.

text.p: The key September 10-year Japanese government bond futures contract was higher at midday on Tuesday, lifted by short-covering, traders said.
The cautious undertone of the Economic Planning Agency's (EPA) monthly economic report released on Tuesday morning also lent support, they said.
"The report's assessment of construction trends and the effects of a rise in the consumption tax was cautious, and that helped to spur buying," a trust bank trader said.
Investor activity was mixed so far, with both buying and selling interest detected, traders said.
September JGBs stood at 126.70 at midday, up from Monday's close of 126.47. Turnover was 15,227 contracs.
The benchmark 182nd JGB yield stood at 2.090 percent as of 0234 GMT, down from the previous day's close of 2.115 percent.
There was little lingering impact from a wire service report which quoted EPA minister Taro Aso as saying on Monday that interest rates may rise by the end of the year, traders said.
Traders said that such an early rise in interest rates seems improbable at this point.
